name: 线程池

taskFlow: ③ 队列满且<max→新建线程

executors.newFixedThreadPool(n): 固定线程/无界队列→OOM风险

content.whyBanExecutors: FixedPool无界队列OOM, CachedPool无限线程OOM; 生产手动ThreadPoolExecutor+有界队列
content.sizeFormula: CPU密集=N+1; IO密集=N*2; 混合型拆两个池

notes: 七参数; 任务先core→队列→max→拒绝; 四种拒绝策略(Abort/CallerRuns/DiscardOldest/Discard); 禁止Executors(无界)
